episodes.title: Overcomer Ministries - Brother Stair’s Cult | A Walterboro Story
episodes.description:
Step inside one of the most controversial and mysterious religious movements in modern American history. “The Cult of Overcomer Ministries” uncovers the rise, fall, and lasting influence of a community shaped by unshakable belief, unchecked authority, and the haunting legacy of its infamous leader.

Brother R.G. Stair was a self-proclaimed end-times prophet who led the secluded Overcomer Ministry compound in rural South Carolina for decades. Known for his 24/7 global shortwave broadcasts, he drew a devoted following convinced they were living in the final days. But behind the sermons and prophecies, allegations of abuse, manipulation, and authoritarian control would ultimately shatter the ministry’s public image and spark nationwide scrutiny.

In this deep-dive documentary, we explore the hidden world behind the sermons, the secluded compound, and the loyal followers who remained even as scandals unraveled the ministry’s foundations. From chilling testimonies to archival broadcasts that once echoed across the nation, this investigation reveals how faith, power, manipulation, and isolation can intertwine in ways that both inspire and destroy.

Whether you’re fascinated by true crime, cults, religious extremism, or the psychology of belief, this documentary sheds light on the forces that draw people in—and the courage it takes to break free.
Discover the shocking truths, the human cost, and the eerie legacy still lingering in the Lowcountry.
